plan.understanding: Replace the largest rounded-rectangle profile corner radius, R63 mm, at all four corners with R50 mm so it matches the other main profile corners while retaining the existing outer bounds.

subtasks.goal: Edit the imported single body by replacing the four convex R63 mm quarter-cylinder corner patches with explicit R50 mm profile patches; do not call an edge-fillet operation. Keep the target anchored to the only largest-radius 90-degree corner family: axis [0.0, 0.966, -0.259], with boundary-circle centers at X=-886.62 and -226.62 in the two section sets (Y,Z)=(-488.91,90.065)/(-369.854,534.391) and (-481.183,87.995)/(-362.126,532.32). In each plane normal to that measured axis, project the adjoining outer support planes X=-949.62, X=-163.62 and the planes having normals [0.0,-0.259,-0.966] and [0.0,0.259,0.966]. Construct a new R50 quarter arc tangent to the same pair of support lines at each corner; its center must therefore be derived from those support lines rather than retained at the old R63 center. Create the exact additive crescent between each old R63 outline and its new R50 outline, sweep it only over the target patch's measured boundary span, and trim it against the unchanged adjoining faces. Where an attached transition patch must change to meet the new arc, replace it with an explicit swept or lofted surface between the new R50 arc and the unchanged neighboring boundary, then sew it into the crescent tool. Fuse all four touching crescent tools to the original body in one boolean operation and refine the result so no separate tool solids or internal splitter faces remain. Preserve the adjoining straight runs and their tangent support planes. Verify one valid solid; four 90-degree cylindrical corner surfaces of radius 50 mm on axis [0.0,0.966,-0.259]; no remaining R63 surface in this targeted outer corner family; continuous tangent corner connections; and unchanged measured bbox [-949.62,-506.698,26.8] to [-163.62,-338.409,595.312].
